title: What's Wrong with Ahmed? The Numbers Behind the Slump
summary: Fiaz Ahmed's average has dropped from 32.8 to 12.4 in recent innings — a 20-point decline.
body:

| Period | Average | Strike Rate |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| Career | 32.8 | 121.7 |
| Last 10 | 12.4 | 83.2 |

The question facing his team: is this a temporary blip or a deeper problem?
